seo.title: 50 Portfolio Project Ideas for Blockchain Engineers
seo.description: Discover portfolio project ideas for blockchain engineers at every skill level. From node implementations to consensus mechanisms, build projects that demonstrate core blockchain expertise.

content.intro: Blockchain engineering goes beyond smart contracts into the infrastructure layer. These projects help you understand how blockchains actually work at the protocol level.

sections.heading: Core Blockchain Concepts
sections.description: Understand blockchain fundamentals by building them.

items.title: Simple Blockchain from Scratch
items.description: Build a basic blockchain with blocks, hashing, and chain validation in any language.

items.title: Proof of Work Implementation
items.description: Add mining with difficulty adjustment to your blockchain.

items.title: Transaction Pool (Mempool)
items.description: Implement a transaction pool with validation and prioritization.

items.title: Merkle Tree Implementation
items.description: Build Merkle trees for efficient transaction verification.

items.title: UTXO Model Implementation
items.description: Build Bitcoin-style unspent transaction outputs for your chain.

items.title: Account Model Implementation
items.description: Build Ethereum-style account-based state for your chain.

items.title: PBFT Implementation
items.description: Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerance for permissioned networks.

items.title: Proof of Stake Validator
items.description: Build a basic PoS system with staking and validator selection.

items.title: Delegated Proof of Stake
items.description: Add delegation mechanics to proof of stake.

items.title: Tendermint-style Consensus
items.description: Implement BFT consensus with propose-prevote-precommit rounds.

items.title: Proof of Authority Chain
items.description: Build a PoA chain for private/consortium use cases.

items.title: Longest Chain Rule Implementation
items.description: Handle chain reorganizations and fork choice correctly.

sections.heading: Networking and P2P
sections.description: Build the network layer for blockchain nodes.

items.title: P2P Node Discovery
items.description: Implement peer discovery using DHT or gossip protocols.

items.title: Block Propagation Network
items.description: Gossip new blocks efficiently across the network.

items.title: Transaction Broadcasting
items.description: Propagate transactions to all nodes efficiently.

items.title: Peer Scoring System
items.description: Score peers based on behavior and prioritize good actors.

items.title: Network Simulator
items.description: Simulate network conditions for testing consensus.

items.title: Light Client Protocol
items.description: Implement light client sync using block headers and proofs.

items.title: Merkle Patricia Trie
items.description: Implement Ethereum's state trie for efficient state proofs.

items.title: State Pruning System
items.description: Prune old state to reduce storage requirements.

items.title: State Sync Protocol
items.description: Fast sync state from other nodes without replaying blocks.

items.title: Archive Node Implementation
items.description: Store and serve historical state for any block.

items.title: Database Backend Comparison
items.description: Benchmark LevelDB, RocksDB, and other backends for blockchain use.

items.title: Simple Stack-based VM
items.description: Build a basic virtual machine for executing transactions.

items.title: Gas Metering System
items.description: Implement gas metering to prevent infinite loops.

items.title: EVM Implementation
items.description: Build a subset of the Ethereum Virtual Machine.

items.title: WASM Runtime Integration
items.description: Integrate WebAssembly runtime for smart contract execution.

items.title: Precompile Implementation
items.description: Add precompiled contracts for cryptographic operations.

items.title: Signature Verification
items.description: Implement ECDSA and EdDSA signature verification.

items.title: BLS Signature Aggregation
items.description: Implement BLS signatures for efficient multi-party signing.

items.title: VDF Implementation
items.description: Build a verifiable delay function for randomness.

items.title: Threshold Signature Scheme
items.description: Implement t-of-n threshold signatures for multi-sig.

items.title: Hash Function Comparison
items.description: Benchmark and compare hash functions for blockchain use.

items.title: Node Monitoring Dashboard
items.description: Monitor node health, sync status, and peer connections.

items.title: RPC Server Implementation
items.description: Build JSON-RPC interface for node interaction.

items.title: Block Explorer Backend
items.description: Index blockchain data for explorer queries.

items.title: Node Deployment Automation
items.description: Automate node deployment with Docker and Kubernetes.

items.title: Checkpoint Sync Implementation
items.description: Fast sync from trusted checkpoints.

items.title: Sharding Prototype
items.description: Implement basic sharding with cross-shard communication.

items.title: Data Availability Sampling
items.description: Implement DAS for light client data availability verification.

items.title: MEV-aware Block Building
items.description: Build a block builder that extracts and distributes MEV.

items.title: Account Abstraction Implementation
items.description: Implement ERC-4337 style account abstraction.

items.title: Blob Transaction Support
items.description: Implement EIP-4844 blob transactions for L2 data.
